steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local id='native-product-return-probe'
local before=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[id])
local palace,returned
for _,work in ipairs(before.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if work.Source.BuildingType=='BUILDING_PALACE' then palace=work
 elseif work.Custodian and work.Custodian~=before.To then returned=work end
end
assert(palace and returned and palace.PhysicalMoved and returned.PhysicalMoved,'saved original works lost their physical proof')
local tx=A.Resume(id)
local moved=0
for _,snap in ipairs(tx.Cities or {}) do
 local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(snap.X,snap.Y))
 if city:GetOwner()==tx.To then moved=moved+1 else assert(city:GetOwner()==tx.From,'old city changed to a third owner') end
end
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do assert(work.PhysicalMoved,'native work proof was replayed or dropped') end
print('[JAC_NATIVE_PRODUCT_CITY_STAGE] status='..tx.Status..' cities='..moved..'/'..#tx.Cities..' finalUI='..tostring(tx.AwaitingFinalUI)..' units='..#tx.Units)
return 'native product city stage '..tx.Status..' '..moved..'/'..#tx.Cities

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local id='native-product-return-probe'
local tx=A.Resume(id)
assert(tx.Status=='COMPLETE','native product absorption did not complete after final publication: '..tx.Status)
local verification=A.RequestVerification(id)
assert(verification and verification.Token,'native product verification publication request absent')
local count=0
for _,snap in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if snap.Custodian then
  local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(snap.Source.Index)
  assert(#found==1,'native work index missing or duplicated after absorption')
  local w=found[1];local slot=snap.TargetSlot
  assert(w.Owner==slot.Owner and w.CityID==slot.City and w.X==slot.X and w.Y==slot.Y and w.Building==slot.Building and w.Slot==slot.Slot,'native work left its exact reserved official slot')
  local source=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(snap.Source.X,snap.Source.Y))
  if source:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(snap.Source.Building) then
   local assets=A.CityAssets(source)
   if snap.Source.BuildingType~='BUILDING_PALACE' then assert(assets[snap.Source.BuildingType].Works[snap.Source.Slot]==-1,'source Temple slot reused') end
  end
  local record=assert(A.GetRoster(snap.Destination)[snap.ID])
  assert(record.NativeWork.Index==w.Index and record.NativeCustody.Owner==w.Owner and record.NativeCustody.City==w.CityID and record.NativeCustody.Building==w.Building and record.NativeCustody.Slot==w.Slot,'native work ledger differs from actual slot')
  count=count+1
 end
end
assert(count==2,'both original works were not verified')
for _,snap in ipairs(tx.Cities or {}) do assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(snap.X,snap.Y):GetOwner()==tx.To,'old city not transferred') end
assert(Players[tx.From]:GetCities():GetCount()==0,'old faction still owns a city')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_PRODUCT_COMPLETE] id='..id..' works='..count..' cities='..#tx.Cities)
return 'same original Palace and returned work complete after save and reload'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local id='native-product-return-probe'
assert(A.Verify(id,true),'reloaded native product verification failed')
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[id])
assert(tx.Status=='COMPLETE' and Players[tx.From]:GetCities():GetCount()==0,'reloaded absorption lost completion')
local count=0
for _,snap in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if snap.Custodian then
  local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(snap.Source.Index)
  assert(#found==1,'reloaded native index missing or duplicated')
  local w=found[1];local slot=snap.TargetSlot
  assert(w.Owner==slot.Owner and w.CityID==slot.City and w.X==slot.X and w.Y==slot.Y and w.Building==slot.Building and w.Slot==slot.Slot,'reloaded original work left its exact reserved slot')
  local record=assert(A.GetRoster(snap.Destination)[snap.ID])
  assert(record.NativeWork.Index==w.Index and record.NativeCustody.Owner==w.Owner and record.NativeCustody.City==w.CityID and record.NativeCustody.Building==w.Building and record.NativeCustody.Slot==w.Slot,'reloaded original work ledger changed')
  count=count+1
 end
end
assert(count==2,'two original works not retained after reload')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_PRODUCT_RELOADED_COMPLETE] id='..id..' works='..count..' cities='..#tx.Cities)
return 'two original works and all donor cities preserved after save reload'
